protocol: user-authorized low-coverage C1 direct training v3
purpose: Test whether substantially more capacity and optimization improve text binding on the current provenance-locked dataset. The user explicitly chose to train without collecting more data; this is diagnostic, not a confirmatory unseen-composition experiment.

data.leakage_rule: The held triple and every transitive source_id, duplicate_group, and pHash<=4 group containing it are excluded from training.
data.known_gate_shortfall: The held triple has 20 rather than 50 independent groups, and cat|playing has 6 rather than 10 training groups. Results must not be described as confirmatory C1 evidence.

training.selection_rule: Use only the final step-30000 EMA inference checkpoint; do not select by loss, samples, or evaluation videos.

iid_prompts: a cat sitting by a window indoors
a cat sitting inside a bag indoors
a cat sitting on a chair indoors
c1_prompts: a cat chasing a shadow indoors
a cat playing with a laser pointer indoors
a cat playing with a straw indoors
a cat playing with a toy lizard indoors
a cat playing with a toy mouse indoors
generation.required_grid: Every listed prompt crossed with every listed seed exactly once, for 13x4=52 videos; no extra or missing generation may enter evaluation.

required: IID and C1 unanimous full-triple accuracy with Wilson 95% intervals
two independent complete prompt-hidden human reviews
